prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- sign_in: 87.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Persona & Voice Customizer Screen: Adds a new interactive voice and persona customization screen right after selecting a pet, allowing users to pick personality traits and audio responses. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (74.4% conversion) and support receives tickets regarding confusion over how to talk to or interact with the pet.)
1: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Desktop Companion Orientation Layout: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a full-bleed interactive visual layout showcasing live pet controls, summon shortcuts, and desktop interaction modes. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support reported multiple issues regarding users being unclear on how to hide, control, or talk to their pet.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Vault Account Restoration Hint: Adds explicit hint text on the sign_in screen explaining that signing in restores existing adopted pets and cloud save data. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Preparation Simulation Flow: Transforms the waiting screen into a stage layout with a interactive desktop simulation widget to practice dragging and interacting while asset generation finishes. (why: Home waiting median time is high (201s) and users reported issues where pet did not appear or they were confused about desktop behavior.)
4: [choose_path, reorder] Story-First Interactive Path Discovery Order: Sets the path selection screen to a story scroll layout that guides users through pet choices with narrative visual preview elements. (why: Median choose_path time is 8s but mean time is 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation before selecting a path.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Compatibility & Generation Status Bar: Adds an estimated timer, system display compatibility check, and desktop readiness toggle on the waiting screen. (why: 15.6% drop-off on waiting step (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support tickets regarding app not opening or pet missing on desktop.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Persona vs Companion Explicit Choice Headline: Updates headline and body text on choose_path screen to explicitly distinguish instant preset adoption from custom creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating initial hesitation due to lack of clarity on what each choice entails.)
